description: Find production runs on this account, newest first. A production run is a batch of production work orders started together under one run number. Each row gives the run's number, when and by whom it started, and how many of its work orders are still open or completed. Filter by state (inProgress while any work order is open, finished once all are completed or cancelled) or text in the run number. Up to 100 per page. Operator credentials only.

search.description: Text to find in the run number.
